config.safeguard: face-state scaling and global conservative flux correction at each SSPRK3 FE-like stage
config.selection: minimum zero-failure validation macro family-by-grid L1 ratio to safeguarded classical FV TENO5; include warmup checkpoint
config.objective: mean per-trajectory component-normalized solution MSE after actual conservative SSPRK3 rollout; no TV or BVD term
config.invalid_policy: reject failed fixed-time rollouts or nonfinite gradient updates, record and stop after three consecutive rejections; no repaired averages
config.limiter_gradient_policy: frozen limiter coefficients and discrete decisions; differentiate accepted flux arithmetic and neural weights
config.inference_retry_policy: at most eight whole-step halvings; advance accepted time only
config.budget_note: same architecture, teacher steps, physics update count, batch size and grid set as saved V2; solver, stage safeguard, normalization and sampling differ, so this is not a causal input-only ablation

training_inputs: actual bidirectional characteristic state stencils from state_stencils
stage_integrator: safeguarded_step at every SSPRK3 stage; no average repairs
